skill.basic_attack.name: Melee Attack
skill.basic_attack.description: Press J to strike in the direction you face. Each swing damages the same target only once. You retain some movement control during the attack.
skill.fireball.name: Fireball
skill.fireball.description: Press K to launch a fireball in the direction you face. Level 1 has a 0.5-second windup; level 2 has a 0.2-second windup with the same damage. Fireballs vanish on hitting a target or wall. Movement is limited while casting.
manual.title: Controls & Help
manual.movement:
Movement & Jumping
Press A / D or ← / → to move. Press Space, W, or ↑ to jump. You cannot jump again while airborne.
manual.combat:
Combat
Press J for a melee attack and K for Fireball. Attacks follow the direction your character faces. Windup, recovery, and movement limits depend on the action.
manual.training:
Training Tools
Press F2 to switch Fireball levels. The red enemy on the right attacks left at fixed intervals. Approach it to fight and watch both health bars. After death, press R or use Reset Training to restore both units, positions, cooldowns, effects, and dummy statistics. Your language is preserved.
manual.languages:
Menu & Language
Press Esc to open the pause menu. Select 简体中文, English, or 日本語 in the language list. A successfully saved choice is restored on the next launch. Close the menu to resume. This prototype training room has no story content.
skill.enemy_attack.name: Enemy Strike
skill.enemy_attack.description: The enemy attempts a left-facing strike every 1.5 seconds, with a 0.3-second windup and 10 damage. It does not track or move.
